:::{#def-gamma}
#### Gamma distribution

A non-negative random variable $T$ has the **gamma distribution**
with shape $\shape > 0$ and rate $\rate > 0$,
written $T \sim \dGamf{\shape, \rate}$,
if $T$ is continuous with [density](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf):

$$
f(t) \eqdef \begin{cases}
\frac{\rate^{\shape}}{\gammafn(\shape)} \, t^{\shape - 1} \ef{-\rate t}, & t > 0 \\
0, & t \le 0
\end{cases}
$$

:::
